About the Report 
This Integrated Annual Report of Bharti Airtel Limited presents the 
Company’s financial and non-financial performance, strategic priorities and 
value creation approach. The report explains how Airtel utilises different 
resources to create value for stakeholders over time.
Reporting Period
This report covers the financial year from 
April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026. Certain 
sections include data from previous years 
to provide context to stakeholders and 
enable meaningful comparison of the 
Company’s performance over time.
Reporting Boundary
The report covers information related 
to the business operations of Bharti 
Airtel Limited across its key operating 
segments. Disclosures are presented 
through the six capitals framework in 
line with the International Integrated 
Reporting approach.
All capitals, except Financial Capital, 
present business information related 
to Airtel’s operations in India, excluding 
Indus Towers Limited, Airtel Payments 
Bank Limited and Beetel Teletech Limited, 
unless specified otherwise. Financial 
Capital parameters are presented on a 
standalone basis for Bharti Airtel Limited.

Material topics
Material topics highlight the areas that matter most to our stakeholders and have a meaningful impact on our business 
outcomes. They are dynamic in nature and may evolve over time in response to changes in the external environment and 
emerging stakeholder expectations. Our material topics undergo a structured prioritisation process and are then reviewed by 
senior management, followed by approval from the Board ESG Committee. These topics are presented in a materiality matrix, 
categorising them as critical, high, or moderate based on their significance to the business and stakeholders.
